subject.title: feat: add per-agent daily model spend alerts

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a new per-agent modelSpend configuration and durable accounting/alert feature, including intentionally best-effort at-most-once notification delivery?
rationale: This is a new user-facing configuration and persisted-state capability, not a repair of an established behavior; the linked issue is also explicitly waiting for maintainer product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the core feature
options.body: Accept the core direction, then require real owner-route proof and explicit fresh-install and existing-database upgrade validation before merge.

options.title: Narrow the proposal
options.body: Keep core only for a generic cost-observation seam and move alert policy or presentation to an owner plugin if that better matches the desired product boundary.

options.title: Decline core scope
options.body: Close the direction as unsupported in core and point contributors toward an external plugin or automation path if a suitable public seam exists.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core feature
recommendation.body: Accept the core direction, then require real owner-route proof and explicit fresh-install and existing-database upgrade validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This change crosses core product scope, agent runtime, configuration, persistence, and channel delivery boundaries.
